result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **Stripe is the best all-around payment processor**\. However, the best choice depends on what platform your store uses, how much you sell, and whether you also sell in person.

If you're starting a small e-commerce business in the U.S., these are the five I'd consider.

## Best payment processors for small online stores

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

Typical U.S. online card fee: 2.9% + \$0.30

- No monthly processing fee.
- Easy integration with most e-commerce platforms.
- Supports subscriptions, Apple Pay, Google Pay and international payments.
- Excellent reporting and fraud-prevention tools.

Website: [Stripe](https://stripe.com)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. PayPal**

(Best for customer trust)

Fees depend on checkout method; standard PayPal checkout is often around 3.49% + \$0.49.

- Many customers already have PayPal accounts.
- Offers familiar checkout options.
- Easy to add to existing online stores.
- Good as an additional payment option alongside Stripe.

Website: [PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/business)

---

![TOOLS WE LOVE – Ecommerce Documentation](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/GkwUoCDfdoCBb7b5tFSQ8zQOTUiuD6OwD9ZQAMvQlDCwlq1cbiNeJibTbhtPGLzcjv8_VVn3F0_0JCEorF1pY_b4TVCHZRpYHc05qjqSwDOpcwHCVRACxbvhewYaz6neyGxKlOkdDI9OUumdRneAPikC43f704y04vHbOhoT2lODfyWS-XKQ8-up3YIIhlgG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

Basic online card rate typically starts at 2.9% + \$0.30.

- Built directly into Shopify.
- No separate payment processor account needed.
- Simplifies refunds, reporting and order management.
- Avoids Shopify's additional third-party transaction fee.

Website: [Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/payments)

---

![Square, Inc Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/o-iRI2kybznmyDubdZ44gVK-vjE6gDKLVakQnJxlACGxko3Nj1jIpWaBRdIuWDcPvStz6IZe1O-k-UExmpEW7lDQ_S559qV-l4JT0xhrWDjCbTjdZDVgBDFR6LW32FKPeauHAWGYSuEdhn0AMiHDAZFaPUNLlmIzwiGcOc7OZzuhVnlNs80uSa8gb9GbKVsf?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

(Best for online and in-person sales)

Online fees typically around 3.3% + \$0.30 on the Free plan.

- Combines online and physical store payments.
- Inventory and sales tracking.
- Easy setup for small businesses.

Website: [Square](https://squareup.com/us/en)

---

![Top five fintech news stories of the week: 28 August 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Nvwm5m0AvFIyEQCoAUiuiBYsES5Z_TGIIL3a7sg7Vv4eL9Itvfc5xa-EyPsr8IsSKHecG5NYexO0SMIejzwZMML07_ctHuEIL4ButxRVQGAmBUqOEkJLjZgpEozhbgzBigkUW3PNM8qwMbcubKNhZeml3Fh_1lYV5P7aYAnQGGfgg1x4XdQzyp-dffUe_NGw?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Helcim**

(Best for growing sales volume)

Interchange-plus pricing; actual costs vary by card and transaction.

- Transparent interchange-plus pricing.
- No standard monthly subscription fee.
- Can become attractive as transaction volume increases.

Website: [Helcim](https://www.helcim.com)

Pricing is indicative U.S. pricing; actual fees vary by plan, card type, payment method and other factors. Sources: [zapier.com](https://zapier.com/blog/best-payment-gateways/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.itechguides.com](https://www.itechguides.com/best-online-payment-solutions-for-businesses-2026-buyers-guide/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/ca/blog/payment-processing-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[dupple.com](https://dupple.com/learn/best-payment-gateways?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

If I were opening a small online store today\:

- **Shopify store\:** Shopify Payments + PayPal.
- **WooCommerce store\:** Stripe + PayPal.
- **Custom-built website\:** Stripe.
- **Online and physical retail\:** Square.

I would generally start with one primary processor and offer PayPal as an additional checkout option.
